title: Momoi Airi — Mysterious Heart Witch〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
We're gonna see how our outfits are coming along today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! I can't wait to see how they're looking!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope the design I sent wasn't too confusing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? I thought it was pretty easy to follow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The ones in charge of putting them together sent us a reply last night, so let's go over each point while keeping your concerns in mind, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's start with our lead dressmaker...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here we are... <Hello, everyone from MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I'll be handling Airi's outfit and I'm beyond ecstatic about being given this opportunity!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I'm only able to provide a sample of what's to come right now, but I honestly can't stop grinning knowing that Airi's going to be wearing this outfit.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And thank you for sending over such a well-annotated design. It was very easy to follow.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I'll be putting everything I have into this to make sure you're satisfied with the finished product.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds like you have nothing to worry about, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad they understood everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since you took the time to redraw it a few times to make sure they'd see what you were thinking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, being able to work on your favorite idol's outfit must be a huge source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we have Minori to thank for that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's see what the others said!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew. That should be all of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like they're all progressing nicely.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And they're gonna send over their samples once they're done, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We'll need to see for ourselves whether or not they actually fit or match our designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After we've checked everything, we'll start having them sew on the decorations and other accessories.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which by no means will be easy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're not exactly professional designers, so I have a feeling that we'll have to learn some things for the first time as we go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We should make it clear that they're always free to ask us for help or suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I forgot to read the postscript for that last email.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's go through it now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<P.S.
Thank you for the blueprint you so kindly attached. I had no issues understanding everything.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I really appreciate how it provides diagrams for the design process and describes why each part is designed the way it is...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I know exactly what I need to do because of it and believe everything should go smoothly.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, the others also responded with similar comments.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A blueprint...? Like for a sewing pattern...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I held a video conference with everyone involved before they got started on their assignments...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it turned out that some of them had never made a pattern out of just a sketched design before.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I decided to take this opportunity to try making my own blueprints.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And Mizuki was there to help, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mizuki...? Oh, you mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember? We met at the Fan Festival when we went to see Minori and when we were shrine maidens for New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mizuki's so talented at designing dresses and other clothes, and has all these different fabrics and materials at home. I even learned about all these handy websites.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... One of them lets you upload your own designs and automatically create sewing patterns based on that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uploading your own designs?!
When did you learn to do that, Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that wasn't her...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The truth is, I had Mizuki help me with most of that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it can make patterns for you.
However, I had no idea how to edit or adjust them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I wrote down how to do all of that...
So I'm hoping that I can learn to do everything myself for next time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's turn that frown upside down. I'm here to help if you ever need me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right! Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We'll need to thank Mizuki later.
Everyone involved in making our outfits too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we do. But we still don't really have much to offer in terms of compensation...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They all said that they're putting everything they have into our outfits, so it'll have to match that somehow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll have to come up with something that they'll all be happy with.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we make that tonight's homework assignment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our outfits are coming along nicely, so we should take this opportunity to think about the other things on our plates.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have a day set aside to discuss what we'll be doing for our stream, so why don't we talk about our ideas then?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that...
Time to make today's practice really count!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
